name: 02822 · Exeter, RI
findings: ZIP 02822 (Exeter) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02822 (Exeter) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02822 (Exeter) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
